items.label: Flickering backlight
items.description: Keeps the backlight on, flickering in the colors of the flames, for as long as this face is showing. Drains the battery much faster.

items.label: Crackling sound
items.description: A very quiet fireplace crackle. Stays silent during Quiet Time and when the speaker is muted

defaultValue: This watch has no settings for Fireplace. The flickering backlight and crackling sound need hardware it doesn't have.
